pins: A gate step whose scripted dispatch outcome is a JSON-encoded STRING verdict (not a plain object) is never unwrapped or re-parsed by the engine; the outcome fails the plain-object check and the run halts as uncertain with the gate-verdict-unparseable diagnostic.
scriptedOutputsShape: Ordered array of objects with fields stepId and output, consumed by dispatch call order (index 0 first). This spec has no parallel, map, or branch structure, so dispatch call order is unambiguous and deterministic. Identical shape used in sentinel-halt.json.
